server_host.description: Hostname of the Soulseek network server to connect to.

server_port.description: Port number of the Soulseek network server.

transfers_shared_directory.description: Path to the directory containing shared files.

transfers_download_directory.description: Path to the directory where downloaded files are saved.

transfers_max_uploads.description: Maximum number of simultaneous uploads allowed.

ui_start_hidden.description: Whether to start the application window hidden (equivalent to -s/--hidden).

ui_headless.description: Whether to start the application in headless mode without a GUI (equivalent to -n/--headless).

environment_gtk_version.description: The major GTK version to use (NICOTINE_GTK_VERSION environment variable).

environment_libadwaita.description: Whether to enable libadwaita/GNOME theme (NICOTINE_LIBADWAITA environment variable).
